doc: The router's rank() as src/router/score.ts has it on 30/09/2026 (docs/multi-computer-design.md §3), so the app's JS port (twoody-app utils/meshRouting.js, lot A2) is checked on the same cases. test/meshContracts.test.ts runs every row against score.ts.

rank: input {computers: ComputerView[], ask: RouteAsk} → expected Choice[] (best first; the first is the pick, the rest the fallbacks). ComputerView = {id, name, self, platform, kind, status: ComputerStatus (account/status.ts), statusAgeMs, loads: last two {cpu_pct, gpu_pct} oldest first, defaultModel?}; RouteAsk = {model: string|null (null = « Automatique »), tools, purpose: 'chat'|'background', tokens, previous?}; Choice = {computerId, name, self, model, loaded, est}.

Constants: status older than 60000 ms out (≥), inflight ≥ 2 out, not loaded with RAM > 90 % out, est = tokens / max(tps, 0.1) + (loaded ? 0 : 10) + inflight × 15, × 1.5 when CPU or GPU > 85 % in both of the last two samples, rounded to 1/100; unmeasured tps = 10 on Linux ARM (or a non-self Linux 'server' without x64/x86/amd64 in its platform), 30 elsewhere; sort by est then self first; self wins if its est ≤ 1.2 × the best; the previous computer keeps it unless the pick's est ≤ 0.7 × its own. Only non-self computers are filtered on status age and purpose.
estimate: {computer, model, tokens} → seconds. prior_tps: {platform, kind, self} → tok/s.
